resolvedAttempts.name: focused-1794
resolvedAttempts.reason: Initial test fixtures assumed a name-matching ultra-saver could not protect itself; the official reminder includes all own matching creatures, and the test now covers self-sacrifice and replacement exclusion. ExactMove does not forward an arbitrary replacement flag; use actual ultra-saver payment. Onikamasu correctly offered its later nonsummon bounce; the targeting-exclusion test explicitly declines that subsequent ability. QA36293 name examples use the actually registered Romanov I and Romanov I GS rather than an unregistered B-Romanov. Public projections omit the library property rather than supplying an empty array. No assertion failure was hidden or counted as passing. Related regression initial 449/450 passed. The sole old phase1760 metadata assertion failed identically because verification.imageSha256 was absent in the unchanged committed manifest; both official bytes matched prior top-level hashes. Copied those verified hashes into the expected verification fields and reran only the failed assertion (1/1 passed). All 450 related assertions are covered by aggregation, with original failed result retained. Initial invariant audit correctly caught a new detail-evidence source mismatch: Red primary manifest selected its text-identical SP print, while appended canonical details correctly cite original 022. catalogueAdditions now describes the actual 022 detail row; both complete prints remain separately verified and IDs/data are unchanged.
